root_cause: The offcanvas plugin treats the panel as a modal dialog, adding aria-modal=true, role=dialog, and a focus-in listener that returns focus to the panel when it leaves, preventing tab navigation to fields outside the panel.
repair_strategy: Remove the modal-specific attribute settings and focus-enforcement logic from the show and hide methods, making the offcanvas behave as a non-modal pane while preserving show/hide animation and backdrop handling.

edits.before:
this._element.removeAttribute('aria-hidden')
    this._element.setAttribute('aria-modal', true)
    this._element.setAttribute('role', 'dialog')
    this._element.classList.add(CLASS_NAME_SHOW)

    const completeCallBack = () => {
      EventHandler.trigger(this._element, EVENT_SHOWN, { relatedTarget })
      this._enforceFocusOnElement(this._element)
    }

EventHandler.off(document, EVENT_FOCUSIN)
    this._element.blur()
    this._isShown = false
    this._element.classList.remove(CLASS_NAME_SHOW)
    this._backdrop.hide()

    const completeCallback = () => {
      this._element.setAttribute('aria-hidden', true)
      this._element.removeAttribute('aria-modal')
      this._element.removeAttribute('role')
      this._element.style.visibility = 'hidden'

      if (!this._config.scroll) {
        scrollBarReset()
      }

      EventHandler.trigger(this._element, EVENT_HIDDEN)
    }

expected_accessibility_effect: Tab navigation will now pass through the offcanvas panel, allowing the amount field to receive focus within the allowed number of tab presses when the panel is open.
functional_risks: Users relying on the offcanvas as a modal dialog may lose modal focus trapping, potentially causing confusion for screen‑reader users.
Removing the focus-in listener may allow focus to wander off the panel when it is intended to be modal.
verification_requirements: Confirm that the amount field receives focus within 6 tab presses after opening the help panel.
Ensure the help panel can still be opened and closed via its trigger and close button.
Verify that the panel’s visibility, hide/show animations, and backdrop behavior remain unchanged.
Check that scrolling behavior when the panel is open is unaffected.
